 Laredo voters have 3 races on the ballot in December 
 By Alex Cano Published : Nov. 16, 2026 at 5:02 PM CST | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LAREDO, Tex. (KGNS) - Voters in Laredo have three races to keep track of in December, following the midterm elections.
 The District 8 special election is set for Dec. 5. Early voting runs from Nov. 23 through Dec. 1.
 Voters will decide two runoff races on Dec. 12. In the race for mayor, Alyssa Cigarroa, a council member, faces Mayor Victor Trevino.
 In the race for Laredo College Board position 9, incumbent Tita Vela faces Eduardo Lopez. Early voting for that race runs from Nov. 30 through Dec. 8.
